user.title: Add virtual RF/IR device
user.description: Create a virtual device that represents an appliance controlled through an existing IR/RF remote. Next you'll pick which set of learned commands it uses.

data_description.name: Friendly name for the appliance (e.g. Family Room Fireplace).
data_description.remote: The remote entity (e.g. a Broadlink transmitter) used to send commands to this appliance.

appliance.title: Choose the appliance
appliance.description: The remote groups its learned commands under a name (its Broadlink "device"). Pick the group this virtual device represents — only its commands will be offered when building controls.

data_description.device: The learned-command group on the remote for this appliance (e.g. great_room_fireplace).

abort.no_commands: No learned commands were found for the selected remote. Learn some commands on it first (this currently reads a Broadlink remote's codes store), then add the device again.

init.title: Manage device
init.description: Buttons, switches, lights, and climates are built from this appliance's learned commands on the remote. Learned commands are read live, so re-learning a command updates every control that uses it. If nothing can be added yet, learn some commands for it on the remote first.

add_button.title: Add button
add_button.description: Create a button control that sends a command learned on the remote.

data_description.name: Button name (e.g. Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the button (e.g. mdi:fire).
data_description.code_id: The learned command this button sends.

manage_button.title: Edit button
manage_button.description: Edit this button, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Button name (e.g. Flicker, Brightness Up).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the button (e.g. mdi:fire).
data_description.code_id: The learned command this button sends.

add_switch.title: Add switch
add_switch.description: Create an on/off switch from commands learned on the remote. For a toggle-only appliance, pick the same command for both on and off.

data_description.name: Switch name (e.g. Power).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the switch (e.g. mdi:fireplace).
data_description.on_code: Command sent when the switch is turned on.
data_description.off_code: Command sent when the switch is turned off.

manage_switch.title: Edit switch
manage_switch.description: Edit this switch, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Switch name (e.g. Power).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the switch (e.g. mdi:fireplace).
data_description.on_code: Command sent when the switch is turned on.
data_description.off_code: Command sent when the switch is turned off.

add_light.title: Add light
add_light.description: Set the power commands and choose how the light dims. For a toggle-only appliance, pick the same command for on and off. Preset lights add their brightness levels next.

data_description.name: Light name (e.g. Counter Lights).
data_description.on_code: Command sent to turn the light on.
data_description.off_code: Command sent to turn the light off.
data_description.dim_mode: On/off only; Preset levels (a code per level); or Up/down (relative brightness_up/down over a list of steps).
data_description.up_code: Relative only: command that steps brightness up one level.
data_description.down_code: Relative only: command that steps brightness down one level.
data_description.steps: Relative only: selectable brightness percentages, one per line or comma-separated (e.g. 10, 30, 60, 100). Need not be evenly spaced.

edit_light_details.title: Edit light
edit_light_details.description: Update the power commands and dimming. Preset lights manage their brightness levels from the light's menu.

data_description.name: Light name (e.g. Counter Lights).
data_description.on_code: Command sent to turn the light on.
data_description.off_code: Command sent to turn the light off.
data_description.dim_mode: On/off only; Preset levels (a code per level); or Up/down (relative brightness_up/down over a list of steps).
data_description.up_code: Relative only: command that steps brightness up one level.
data_description.down_code: Relative only: command that steps brightness down one level.
data_description.steps: Relative only: selectable brightness percentages, one per line or comma-separated (e.g. 10, 30, 60, 100). Need not be evenly spaced.

manage_light.title: Edit light
manage_light.description: Edit the power commands and dimming. Preset lights can also add or remove brightness levels (the slider snaps to the nearest). Choose Done when finished.

data_description.code_id: The learned command that sets this brightness level.

add_climate.title: Add climate
add_climate.description: Enable heat, cool, or both. For a toggle-only unit, use the same command for the mode and off. Enter one target temperature per line; the dial snaps to the nearest and steps with up/down.

data_description.name: Climate name (e.g. Great Room Fireplace).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the climate entity.
data_description.heat_code: Command sent to enter heat mode (required if heat is enabled).
data_description.cool_code: Command sent to enter cool mode (required if cool is enabled).
data_description.off_code: Command sent to turn the unit off (may equal a mode command for toggle units).
data_description.up_code: Command sent to move up one temperature step.
data_description.down_code: Command sent to move down one temperature step.
data_description.temperatures: One selectable target temperature per line. They need not be evenly spaced.
data_description.target_temp: Optional starting target. Defaults to the lowest temperature.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional sensor for the real current temperature. If unset, the current temperature mirrors the target.

manage_climate.title: Edit climate
manage_climate.description: Edit this climate, or choose Done to go back.

data_description.name: Climate name (e.g. Great Room Fireplace).
data_description.icon: Optional icon for the climate entity.
data_description.heat_code: Command sent to enter heat mode (required if heat is enabled).
data_description.cool_code: Command sent to enter cool mode (required if cool is enabled).
data_description.off_code: Command sent to turn the unit off (may equal a mode command for toggle units).
data_description.up_code: Command sent to move up one temperature step.
data_description.down_code: Command sent to move down one temperature step.
data_description.temperatures: One selectable target temperature per line. They need not be evenly spaced.
data_description.target_temp: Optional starting target. Defaults to the lowest temperature.
data_description.temp_sensor: Optional sensor for the real current temperature. If unset, the current temperature mirrors the target.

error.need_mode: Enable at least one of heat or cool.
error.invalid_temps: Each line must be a number (one temperature per line).
error.invalid_steps: Each brightness step must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
error.steps_required: Enter at least one brightness step.
